summary: The data audit was clean (0 errors in 63 videos). Fixed one bug in the new unit-ladder check that failed true stories, wrote 4 video verdicts, the Monday channel review and the Sunday picture tally.
why: The 14 Nov unit-ladder check counted story time ('a year later', 'one night in 1998') as rates, which would fail good scripts; the analysis is due every night, the channel review on Mondays and the tally on Sundays.

findings.title: Data audit clean
findings.detail: 15 Nov audit: 76 videos, 63 checked against YouTube, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The 13 Nov view-count errors did not come back.

findings.title: Viewers leave on the second line
findings.detail: In 20 of 26 Shorts of the last 3 weeks the steepest fall is at 4.5-7 s; the MrBeast Short lost 41 points at 5.3 s on an all-creators total.

findings.title: The 13 Nov Shorts were our best starts
findings.detail: Eras Tour 994 views at 48 h, MrBeast vs IShowSpeed 955, Netflix 485 in 2.1 days, against a median of 83.

findings.title: Worst option: the plum palette
findings.detail: 16.4% held after the hook (7 Shorts) vs 26.6% for the other palettes (19), partly October's older recipe.

changes.title: Unit-ladder check skips story time
changes.detail: generator/story.py: 'a year later', 'one night in 1998', 'a week before' no longer count as rates; test added.

changes.title: Analytics analysis
changes.detail: improvement/analysis/videos.json (4 verdicts), channel.json (weekly review), pictures.json (picture tally).
